summary.text: Jamie Wall is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin Senate representing District 30, based in Green Bay, elected to the Senate in 2024.
He serves on the Committee on Insurance, Housing, Rural Issues and Forestry and the Joint Legislative Council.

paragraphs.text: Wall was born in Green Bay, Wisconsin, on September 7, 1971.
He graduated from Wrightstown High School in 1989, earned a B.A. from the University of Wisconsin-Madison in 1993, and received an MPhil from the University of Oxford in 1997.
The Legislature's page lists him as a former principal of Askeaton Advisors and a former administrator in the Division of Economic Development at the Wisconsin Department of Commerce.
He is vice president of the Green Bay Water Commission and treasurer of the Astor East River Neighborhood Association, and a former director of the Wisconsin 4-H Foundation.
He is also a member of the Governor's Council on Workforce Investment, the Wisconsin Council on Forestry and the Wisconsin Economic Development Corporation.
